fun.en: Russia spans 11 time zones, more than any other country in the world.
fun.zh: 俄羅斯橫跨11個時區，是全球時區最多的國家。

fun.en: Women hold more than 60% of seats in Rwanda's lower house of parliament, among the highest shares in the world.
fun.zh: 盧安達國會下議院超過六成席次由女性擔任，比例居全球前列。

fun.en: Saudi Arabia has no permanent rivers or natural lakes despite being one of the largest countries in the world.
fun.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯國土遼闊，卻沒有常年有水的河流。

fun.en: Sudan has more ancient pyramids than Egypt, with over 200 built by the Kushite kingdoms of Nubia.
fun.zh: 蘇丹的金字塔數量比埃及還多，超過200座，由古代庫施王國興建。

fun.en: Senegal's Lake Retba, also called Lac Rose, appears pink because of salt-loving algae and bacteria.
fun.zh: 塞內加爾的玫瑰湖因耐鹽藻類與細菌而呈現粉紅色。

fun.en: Singapore has expanded its land area by roughly a quarter since independence, mostly through land reclamation from the sea.
fun.zh: 新加坡獨立後靠填海造陸，國土面積增加了約四分之一。

fun.en: The Solomon Islands consist of nearly 1,000 islands, and about 70 indigenous languages are spoken there.
fun.zh: 索羅門群島由近千座島嶼組成，境內使用約70種原住民語言。

fun.en: Sierra Leone's name comes from the Portuguese 'Serra Leoa', meaning 'Lion Mountains'.
fun.zh: 獅子山的名稱源自葡萄牙語「Serra Leoa」，意為「獅子山脈」。

fun.en: El Salvador is the smallest country in Central America and the only one with no Caribbean coastline.
fun.zh: 薩爾瓦多是中美洲面積最小的國家，也是唯一沒有加勒比海岸線的國家。

fun.en: San Marino is traditionally said to have been founded in 301 CE, making it one of the oldest surviving states.
fun.zh: 聖馬利諾傳統上認為建於西元301年，是現存最古老的國家之一。

fun.en: Somalia has the longest coastline on mainland Africa, at over 3,000 kilometres.
fun.zh: 索馬利亞的海岸線超過3,000公里，是非洲大陸最長的。

fun.en: Serbia is one of the world's largest raspberry exporters, supplying a big share of Europe's frozen raspberries.
fun.zh: 塞爾維亞是全球主要的覆盆子出口國，供應歐洲大量冷凍覆盆子。

fun.en: South Sudan became the world's newest UN member state when it gained independence in July 2011.
fun.zh: 南蘇丹在2011年7月獨立，是聯合國最新的會員國之一。

fun.en: The equator passes through São Tomé and Príncipe, crossing the small Ilhéu das Rolas islet.
fun.zh: 赤道穿過聖多美普林西比的羅拉斯小島。

fun.en: Suriname is about 90% covered by forest, one of the most heavily forested countries on Earth.
fun.zh: 蘇利南約九成國土被森林覆蓋，是全球森林覆蓋率最高的國家之一。

fun.en: Slovakia produces more cars per capita than any other country in the world.
fun.zh: 斯洛伐克平均每人汽車產量居全球第一。

fun.en: More than half of Slovenia is covered by forest, making it one of the greenest countries in Europe.
fun.zh: 斯洛維尼亞超過一半國土是森林，是歐洲最綠的國家之一。

fun.en: Sweden has around 267,000 islands, more than any other country in the world.
fun.zh: 瑞典擁有約26.7萬座島嶼，數量為世界之最。

fun.en: Eswatini changed its name from Swaziland in 2018 to mark 50 years of independence.
fun.zh: 史瓦帝尼在2018年由「史瓦濟蘭」更名，以紀念獨立50週年。

fun.en: Sint Maarten shares a small island with French Saint-Martin, and jets land just above sunbathers at Maho Beach.
fun.zh: 荷屬聖馬丁與法屬聖馬丁共享一座小島，飛機會低空掠過馬荷灣海灘的遊客。

fun.en: Seychelles' coco de mer palm produces the heaviest seed in the plant kingdom, weighing up to about 20 kilograms.
fun.zh: 塞席爾的海椰子是全球最重的種子，重量可達約20公斤。

fun.en: Damascus is often cited as one of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities.
fun.zh: 大馬士革常被認為是世界上持續有人居住最久的城市之一。

fun.en: Lake Chad has shrunk by roughly 90% since the 1960s, one of the most dramatic lake declines on record.
fun.zh: 查德湖自1960年代以來縮小了約九成，是最劇烈的湖泊萎縮案例之一。

fun.en: Togo's capital Lomé sits right next to the Ghana border, one of the few capitals almost on a national frontier.
fun.zh: 多哥首都洛梅緊鄰迦納邊界，是少數幾乎位於國界上的首都。

top_export.zh: 機械與電子產品（電腦、積體電路）

fun.en: Thailand, formerly called Siam, is the only Southeast Asian country never colonized by a European power.
fun.zh: 泰國舊稱暹羅，是東南亞唯一未被歐洲國家殖民的國家。

fun.en: More than 90% of Tajikistan is mountainous, including part of the Pamir range known as the 'Roof of the World'.
fun.zh: 塔吉克超過九成國土是山地，包括有「世界屋脊」之稱的帕米爾高原。

fun.en: Turkmenistan's Darvaza gas crater has been burning for decades and is nicknamed the 'Door to Hell'.
fun.zh: 土庫曼的達瓦札天然氣坑已燃燒數十年，綽號「地獄之門」。

fun.en: Timor-Leste is one of only two predominantly Catholic countries in Asia, alongside the Philippines.
fun.zh: 東帝汶與菲律賓是亞洲僅有的兩個以天主教為主的國家。

fun.en: Tonga has about 170 islands, but only around 36 of them are inhabited.
fun.zh: 東加約有170座島嶼，但只有約36座有人居住。

top_export.en: Refined petroleum and natural gas products

fun.en: The steelpan, made from oil drums, was invented in Trinidad and Tobago in the 20th century.
fun.zh: 鋼鼓是20世紀在千里達及托巴哥以油桶發明的樂器。

fun.en: The fictional planet Tatooine in Star Wars was named after the Tunisian town of Tataouine, where scenes were filmed.
fun.zh: 《星際大戰》的虛構星球塔圖因，名稱取自突尼西亞的塔塔溫，並在當地取景。

fun.en: Göbekli Tepe in Türkiye, built about 11,000 years ago, is older than Stonehenge by thousands of years.
fun.zh: 土耳其的哥貝克力石陣約建於一萬一千年前，比巨石陣早數千年。

fun.en: Tuvalu earns significant income from licensing its internet domain '.tv', which suits television companies.
fun.zh: 吐瓦魯靠授權網域「.tv」賺取可觀收入，電視相關公司愛用。

fun.en: Taiwan accounts for more than half of the world's contract chip manufacturing revenue, led by TSMC.
fun.zh: 台灣的晶圓代工產值占全球一半以上，由台積電領軍。

fun.en: Tanzania is home to Mount Kilimanjaro, at 5,895 metres the highest mountain in Africa.
fun.zh: 坦尚尼亞的吉力馬札羅山海拔5,895公尺，是非洲最高峰。

fun.en: Uganda has one of the youngest populations in the world, with a median age of about 16.
fun.zh: 烏干達是全球人口最年輕的國家之一，年齡中位數約16歲。

top_export.zh: 穀物（玉米、小麥）與葵花油

fun.en: Kyiv's Arsenalna metro station, about 105 metres underground, is the deepest metro station in the world.
fun.zh: 基輔的兵工廠站深約105公尺，是世界最深的地鐵站。

fun.en: Uruguay hosted and won the first FIFA World Cup in 1930.
fun.zh: 烏拉圭在1930年主辦並奪得史上第一屆世界盃足球賽冠軍。

fun.en: The United States has no official language at the federal level, even though English is the most widely used.
fun.zh: 美國聯邦層級沒有官方語言，儘管英語使用最普遍。

fun.en: Uzbekistan is one of only two doubly landlocked countries in the world, along with Liechtenstein.
fun.zh: 烏茲別克與列支敦斯登是世界上僅有的兩個雙重內陸國。

fun.en: Vatican City is the smallest country in the world, at about 0.44 square kilometres, with fewer than 1,000 residents.
fun.zh: 梵蒂岡是世界最小的國家，面積約0.44平方公里，居民不到一千人。

fun.en: Scenes of the first Pirates of the Caribbean film were shot at Wallilabou Bay on Saint Vincent.
fun.zh: 第一部《神鬼奇航》的部分場景在聖文森的瓦里拉布灣拍攝。

fun.en: Venezuela's Angel Falls, at 979 metres, is the tallest uninterrupted waterfall in the world.
fun.zh: 委內瑞拉的天使瀑布高979公尺，是世界落差最大的不間斷瀑布。

fun.en: Vietnam is the world's second-largest coffee producer after Brazil.
fun.zh: 越南是僅次於巴西的全球第二大咖啡生產國。

top_export.en: Coconut products (copra, coconut oil) and beef

fun.en: Land diving on Vanuatu's Pentecost Island is widely regarded as the origin of modern bungee jumping.
fun.zh: 萬那杜五旬節島的陸地跳塔儀式，被廣泛視為現代高空彈跳的起源。

fun.en: In December 2011 Samoa skipped 30 December entirely when it moved to the west side of the International Date Line.
fun.zh: 薩摩亞在2011年12月改到國際換日線西側，直接跳過了12月30日。

fun.en: Kosovo has one of the youngest populations in Europe, with a median age of around 30.
fun.zh: 科索沃是歐洲人口最年輕的地區之一，年齡中位數約30歲。

fun.en: Yemen's Socotra Island hosts dragon blood trees, and about a third of its plant species grow nowhere else.
fun.zh: 葉門索科特拉島有龍血樹，約三分之一的植物種類為當地獨有。

fun.en: South Africa has three capital cities: Pretoria, Cape Town and Bloemfontein.
fun.zh: 南非有三個首都：普利托利亞、開普敦與布隆泉。

fun.en: Zambia shares Victoria Falls with Zimbabwe; locals call it Mosi-oa-Tunya, meaning 'the smoke that thunders'.
fun.zh: 尚比亞與辛巴威共享維多利亞瀑布，當地稱為「雷鳴之煙」。

fun.en: Zimbabwe's name is thought to derive from 'dzimba dza mabwe', meaning 'houses of stone', after Great Zimbabwe.
fun.zh: 辛巴威國名據信源自「石頭房屋」，指大辛巴威遺址。
